title: Custom Reagent Plate Filling Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol performs a custom reagent plate filling for the [MagMax Core Protocol](https://www.thermofisher.com/document-connect/document-connect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.thermofisher.com%2FTFS-Assets%2FLSG%2Fmanuals%2FMAN0015944_MagMAXCORE_NA_Kit_UG.pdf).
Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters in the fields provided above.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your labware files with .json extensions (if needed).

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App’s Protocol tab, upload your protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate your labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App; refer to the support articles for calibration tips.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the “Run” button to start the protocol.
